newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria c.bank allots 7.54 bln ats in 2-wk repos.
newsitem.headline: Austria c.bank allots 7.54 bln ats in 2-wk repos.

text.p: The Austrian National Bank said on Friday it allocated 7.54 billion schillings in two-week securities repurchase agreements, or repos, at a fixed rate of three percent.
The bank said it had filled seven percent of the bids.
Last week the bank allotted 6.44 billion schillings, filling nine percent of the bids, also at a fixed rate of three percent. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
